name: Experimental study of the nucleon structure functions and of the gluon distribution from charged-current neutrino and antineutrino interactions

summary.plain: CHARM measured how quarks share a nucleon's momentum by studying neutrino and antineutrino collisions in its detector at CERN. It determined the structure functions F2 and xF3 and the antiquark content as functions of the collision variables x and Q squared.
summary.technical: Inclusive nu and nu-bar charged-current scattering in the CHARM detector in the SPS wide-band beams; x and Q^2 dependence of F2 and xF3 and of the antiquark distribution determined, with the gluon distribution extracted from the Q^2 evolution.

title: Experimental study of the nucleon structure functions and of the gluon distribution from charged-current neutrino and antineutrino interactions
why_it_matters: An early high-statistics measurement of the scaling violations of the nucleon structure functions, testing perturbative QCD with neutrino beams.
